sourceWindows: CURRENT / CLUB-FACING: https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/mykki-blanco-cafe-paradiso and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-alien-metal — September 9 and August 19, 2026 reviews were inspected; Butt Sex, FOXES, Rapid Alpha Decay and Level 5 survive as exact tracks with club, jungle, phase-change or stop-and-return hypotheses.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/helena-hauff-qualm — Helena Hauff's 2018 Qualm was inspected as an untouched hardware-techno window; btdr-revisited, The Smell of Suds and Steel and Hyper-Intelligent Genetically Enriched Cyborg survive on exact-track structural or texture evidence.
FRESHNESS CHECK: current canonical, rejected, revisit, target-local discovery and 218-track utility state contain no prior artist-title decision for the nine requested identities.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and unresolved prior leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.

Runs 109–113 selected artist and label ecosystems were not retried; the scan deliberately moved away from Barker/Toni Geitani, SHERELLE/KAY BE, Lara Sarkissian/P. Adrix, KAVARI/Overmono/Sote and Skrillex/Daphni/Sam Prekop.
Current ambient, rock and rap-adjacent sources were admitted only where a concrete rhythmic, structural or boundary hypothesis survived; genre distance was neither an automatic pass nor fail.
No Spotify connector, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
